page.content:
State's key witness who said he helped Adnan bury Hae.

How Jay Wilds connects

  • Work: Serial Season 1 — Jay Wilds is the state's key witness in the Season 1 case.
  • Character: Adnan Syed — Jay Wilds testified that he helped Adnan after Hae's death.

What is Jay Wilds?

Jay Wilds is the acquaintance whose changing story — that Adnan showed him Hae's body and that they buried her in Leakin Park — became the prosecution spine Koenig keeps testing.

Key threads lead to Serial Season 1 and Adnan Syed.
